description: Convert an API collection between formats, entirely offline. Reads Postman v2.1, Insomnia, Bruno .bru, OpenAPI 3.x / Swagger 2.0 (JSON or YAML), a browser HAR, or curl commands - the format is detected. Writes Postman, Bruno (as a file tree) or curl. Reports what cannot be translated (Postman/Bruno scripts, file fields, Insomnia templates) instead of dropping it silently.

input.description: The collection, specification or curl commands, as text

name: api_collection_convert
